content:
**Stable Tools** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Once in a Blue Moon* update (following patch 46).

Power Tools break increasingly slower.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Power Tools break 40% slower. | 006D507D | 
| ★★ | 2 | Power Tools break 25% slower. | 006D507E | 
| ★ | 1 | Power Tools break 10% slower. | 006D507F | 

| Thrown Weapons | | | 
| Auto axe | Chainsaw | Drill | 
| Mr. Handy buzz blade | Ripper | | 

This perk was created by systems designer JP Salman, who developed it alongside the UI team working on the game. According to Salman, its introduction was meant to be a follow-up to the release of the auto axe with the *Expeditions: The Pitt* update. [1]
